prompt:
Create a final round-2 Minecraft builder reference sheet for PIKE PLACE • SOUTH & EAST MARKETS. Landscape 3:2, plain warm ivory background, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel blocks, skilled human builder quality, no characters or animals. Use attached image 1 as mood/material reference and image 2 as previous concept to refine. Preserve its warm dusk lighting, brick and cream palette, Economy glass atrium, striped produce stalls, painted signs and Garden Center fire escape.

LAYOUT: exactly TWO VIEWS SIDE BY SIDE, LEFT a straight-on orthographic front elevation of the four modules in numbered order Economy, Corner, Sanitary, Garden Center; RIGHT an orthographic three-quarter view of the same four modules at the SAME BLOCK SCALE. Both groups must fit with generous space. An ordered exploded catalog presentation, clearly separated modules, not an invented continuous street. Left may show each module's primary street elevation; right preserves shared true world axes and shows the site relationship: Economy and Corner south at Pike Street (high z), Sanitary extends north along z on the east side of Pike Place, Garden Center farther north at Post Alley. Small orientation diagram: +x EAST / UPHILL, -x BAY / DOWNHILL, +z PIKE STREET. Do not turn individual buildings to face camera in the three-quarter site view. Small header and restrained labels; a compact palette strip below, no extra architectural views.

THREE CORRECTIONS: (1) restore real distinct footprints and orientations rather than a straight terrace; narrow irregular stepped perimeter shapes, no giant rectangular podiums; (2) Corner has THREE clear storeys, ground arched stalls plus TWO regular tall-window upper levels, Economy and Sanitary each TWO principal storeys; (3) show exposed lower brick storeys on the west/downhill side of Economy, descending to sloped ground, rather than hiding all lower building mass behind a uniform stone retaining wall. Foundations follow terrain and support every wall; no floating or buried buildings. Use stepped ground and short local retaining walls only. All projections, stairs, greenery and awnings stay inside each module footprint.

DIMENSION / MASSING LIMITS at 1.4 blocks/metre: Economy module 58 x 102 maximum, irregular occupied main mass concentrated in its northern two thirds with narrow southern fragments, highest actual roof approximately y54 above local lowest ground (hard cap84), ground rises west-to-east 0..20. Corner 62 x102 maximum, main irregular mass in southern three quarters, small detached northern footprint remnant, roof approximately y39 (hard cap62), ground rises 1..13. Sanitary 79 x155 maximum, long tapered irregular north-south footprint with west-facing market frontage, roof approximately y33 (hard cap53), ground 0..10. Garden Center42 x32, modest tapered two-storey brick building roof approximately y17 (hard cap33), ground 0..6. These are separate module dimensions, do not stretch Garden Center to match larger buildings. Visually honor their unequal scale and low flat roofs.

ARCHITECTURE: Economy red-brown brick, large recessed arched glass entrance on south/Pike Street elevation, cream stepped arch surround, glass skylit atrium behind parapet, white-framed windows, flat dark roof. Lower downhill brick facade with real windows and vertical pilasters. Corner red-brown brick three storeys, recessed big masonry arches at ground, open produce shops and red/white and green/white canvas awnings, TWO upper rows tall white-framed windows, cream sill bands, projecting stair/slab cornice and parapet, flat roof. Sanitary long TWO-storey cream stucco/concrete mass, small upper windows, deep open-front shops on west/Pike Place face under striped awnings, dark green painted SANITARY PUBLIC MARKET lettering over entrance, flat dark roof with shallow parapet. Garden Center small TWO-storey red brick, GARDEN CENTER painted sign, Post Alley shopfronts, exterior iron fire escape with switchback stair and landings. All facades have recessed openings, projecting trim, realistic flat roof edges with slab caps, subtle vents and brick chimneys, no pitched main roofs. Exterior only with shallow lit shop displays visible through glass.

VANILLA MINECRAFT JAVA 1.21.1 MATERIALS ONLY, exact ids: bricks, brick_stairs, brick_slab, brick_wall, granite for occasional brick variation; smooth_sandstone, smooth_sandstone_stairs, smooth_sandstone_slab for cream walls and arches; smooth_quartz, quartz_stairs, quartz_slab for white trim; stone_bricks, stone_brick_stairs, stone_brick_slab, stone_brick_wall for foundations and steps; stone_slab and gray_concrete flat roofs; glass, glass_pane, white_stained_glass_pane atrium and windows; red_wool, white_wool, green_wool awnings; iron_bars, stone_brick_stairs, stone_brick_slab fire escape; spruce_planks, spruce_stairs, spruce_slab, spruce_fence, spruce_trapdoor, spruce_door stalls/joinery; lantern and glowstone warm lighting; barrel, chest, flower_pot, potted_fern, pumpkin, melon produce/decor; oak_leaves greenery; spruce_sign painted shop signs. No pale oak or later-version blocks, no invented curved pieces, no smooth non-voxel geometry. Represent lettering as blocky painted signage. Warm amber shop and window lights read at dusk while masonry stays legible on the plain light background. Bottom palette swatches with short exact block ids. Two clear large architectural views, no decorative sunset backdrop.

roles.role: Foundations, retaining walls, paving and stairs
Flat roofs, parapet caps and vents

changes: Generated with the built-in image tool and saved as concept-2.png in the current directory.

The previous concept's three biggest shortcomings were its continuous terrace arrangement, Corner Market's missing second upper window row, and uniform retaining walls concealing Economy's downhill storeys.
Replaced stacked views with the requested side-by-side elevation and three-quarter presentation, with numbered buildings and a block palette.
Exposed Economy's lower brick storeys, windows and pilasters, with stepped access descending toward the downhill ground.
Retained the cream atrium arch, glass skylight, striped stalls, warm lighting, projecting cornices and Garden Center fire escape.

Inspection limitation: the generated image still joins the buildings into a terrace and shows only one clear upper window row on Corner Market. Exact footprint occupancy, site orientation and matching view scales are not established by this illustration; the supplied maps remain authoritative.
Small produce displays and painted lettering are illustrative; their individual block construction cannot be verified from the raster image.
